title: Lightly Sweet Norwegian Sweet Potatoes Wrap
description: A quick-fix, keto-friendly dish featuring sweet potatoes, a hint of ferment, and a winey flavor wrapped in a corn-husk vessel.

ingredients.name: corn husks
ingredients.notes: large enough to wrap the filling

instructions: Pierce the sweet potatoes with a fork a few times and bake for 45 minutes, or until soft.
Let the sweet potatoes cool slightly, then peel and mash in a bowl.
In a small bowl, mix together the butter, honey, cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the yeast to the bowl and mix until fully dissolved.
Add the yeast mixture to the mashed sweet potatoes and stir to combine.
Place a corn husk on a flat surface and spread a quarter of the sweet potato mixture onto the center of the husk.
Add a sprinkle of parsley on top of the sweet potato mixture.
Fold the sides of the corn husk over the filling and then roll the husk up to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to form 3 more wraps.
